APP_CRYPTO_KEY.description: Generate an independent high-entropy value used to encrypt provider credentials and authenticate provider jobs and callbacks.

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Generate an independent high-entropy value. You will enter it once on the first-run setup screen.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-analytics.mjs && vite build && node scripts/sanitize-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.workers-test.json
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint --max-warnings 0 && pnpm test && pnpm test:workers && pnpm build
scripts.r2:lifecycle: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set ai-tracker-evidence --file infrastructure/r2-lifecycle.json --force
scripts.deploy: pnpm db:migrate:remote && pnpm deploy:analytics && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry: pnpm build && pnpm deploy:analytics -- --dry-run && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:getbelki: node scripts/deploy-analytics.mjs --profile deployment/getbelki.json && node scripts/deploy-profile.mjs --profile deployment/getbelki.json
scripts.deploy:getbelki:dry: pnpm build && node scripts/deploy-analytics.mjs --profile deployment/getbelki.json --dry-run && node scripts/deploy-profile.mjs --profile deployment/getbelki.json --dry-run
